cases.pr_title: Add remote marker validation and update operator notes
cases.pr_body: Validate marker files on remote collectors and document the new remote check.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/operator.md b/docs/operator.md
index 222aaaa..333bbbb 100644
--- a/docs/operator.md
+++ b/docs/operator.md
@@ -20,3 +20,6 @@ Collection checks
+Remote marker validation uses the caller-supplied marker path on the target host.
+Debug mode only adds diagnostics; it does not force a deep review or change review scope.

diff --git a/.github/dcoir_review/command.py b/.github/dcoir_review/command.py
index 444aaaa..555bbbb 100644
--- a/.github/dcoir_review/command.py
+++ b/.github/dcoir_review/command.py
@@ -30,4 +30,5 @@ def resolve_mode(flags):
     if "deep" in flags:
         return "deep"
+    if "debug" in flags:
+        return "deep"
     return "incremental"

cases.ground_truth_rationale: The remote script block fails to capture MarkerPath from the caller, and the command resolver contradicts the documentation by making debug force deep mode.

cases.pr_title: Clarify debug observability and stale-run handling
cases.pr_body: Keep debug as observability-only, cancel superseded runs, and revalidate head immediately before publication.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/operator.md b/docs/operator.md
index 111aaaa..222bbbb 100644
--- a/docs/operator.md
+++ b/docs/operator.md
@@ -20,2 +20,4 @@ Review modes
+Debug adds progress and artifacts without changing deep/incremental review scope.
+Superseded review runs must not publish against a newer PR head.

diff --git a/.github/workflows/review.yml b/.github/workflows/review.yml
index 333aaaa..444bbbb 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/review.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/review.yml
@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@
 name: review
 on: issue_comment
+concurrency:
+  group: review-${{ github.event.issue.number }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
 jobs:

diff --git a/review/publish.py b/review/publish.py
index 555aaaa..666bbbb 100644
--- a/review/publish.py
+++ b/review/publish.py
@@ -10,5 +10,8 @@ def review_and_publish(client, pr_number):
     head = client.get_pr(pr_number)["head"]["sha"]
     result = run_expensive_review(head)
+    current = client.get_pr(pr_number)["head"]["sha"]
+    if current != head:
+        return "superseded"
     client.publish_review(pr_number, result)

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Workflow cancellation and an immediate pre-publication head check are consistent with the documented stale-run contract; debug wording is observability-only.

cases.pr_title: Include PR title in diagnostic bundle
cases.pr_body: Print the PR title into diagnostic output so uploaded artifacts are easier to identify.

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/diagnostic.yml b/.github/workflows/diagnostic.yml
index 111aaaa..222bbbb 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/diagnostic.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/diagnostic.yml
@@ -8,4 +8,6 @@ jobs:
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Label diagnostics
+        run: echo "PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" >> diagnostics.txt
       - run: python .github/scripts/collect-diagnostics.py

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Untrusted PR-title text is substituted directly into a run script, allowing shell metacharacters in the title to alter execution; it should cross the expression boundary via env/input data.
